item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00218","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C08","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C18 plausibly supplied a concrete substantive and structural template for the later order. It establishes the same Board of Consultants for foreign-intelligence oversight, specifies periodic review at six-month intervals, covers government-wide foreign-intelligence activities while emphasizing the Central Intelligence Agency and key departmental intelligence elements, and anticipates consultation with the Director of Central Intelligence. C08 independently contains much of the same machinery and is a very strong secondary antecedent. C02 shares the establishment, appointment, uncompensated service, and unusually specific funding provisions, but is less closely matched to the child's substantive mission.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby established the President's Board of Consultants on Foreign Intelligence Activities","parent_excerpt":"I am establishing a Board of Consultants on foreign intelligence activities of this Government","explanation":"The documents create the same specifically named and tasked advisory body."},{"child_excerpt":"shall report its findings to the President semi-annually or at more frequent intervals","parent_excerpt":"This Board should meet not less often than once every six months","explanation":"Both prescribe essentially the same semiannual minimum review cycle."},{"child_excerpt":"Such reports shall embrace ... the performance by the Central Intelligence Agency of its functions [and] ... the principal intelligence elements of executive departments and other agencies","parent_excerpt":"the review ... would be concerned with all Government foreign intelligence activities [with] particular detailed attention ... on the work of the Central Intelligence Agency and ... intelligence elements ... in other departments and agencies","explanation":"The later order converts C18's scope and emphasis into formal operative language."},{"child_excerpt":"shall consult from time to time with the Director of Central Intelligence","parent_excerpt":"meet with Mr. Allen W. Dulles, Director of Central Intelligence ... to determine the scope of your review","explanation":"Both contemplate direct consultation with the intelligence director as part of defining and conducting the review."}]}
